transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because… at work I keep not finishing things all the way. Like I’ll start the sanitation steps, or the batch logs, or the end-of-line paperwork, and somehow I miss the last parts. Even when I know it really matters for my job.
Do you find yourself getting easily distracted while working on these tasks?

Yeah… I do. Even when I come in trying to really focus, after a while the cutting and weighing and checking labels kind of all run together. Then I catch myself just staring at the same tray or the log sheet and not really knowing what I was supposed to do next.
Do you feel anxious or worried when you're working on these tasks?
Um… I don’t know if I’d call it anxious. I get frustrated, maybe a little tense when I realize I’m behind or I missed something, but I’m not sure.
Do you often feel anxious in your daily life, outside of work?
Not really… I mean, I don’t think I’m anxious most of the time. Outside of work I haven’t really noticed that being a big thing.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?
I don’t think so… not in a way I’ve really noticed. Maybe I shift around sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it’s a big thing.
Do you often feel guilty or self-critical about things that happen in your daily life?
I mean… sometimes I’m hard on myself if I mess something up, but I don’t know if I’d say I feel guilty a lot. I haven’t really thought about it that way.
Do you often feel worthless?
Not really… I don’t think I feel worthless. I mean, I have bad days, but… not like that, I guess.
Do you often feel sad or depressed?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t really say depressed. I get down sometimes, I guess, but I haven’t really thought of it as, like, sadness all the time.
Do you often worry about things for a long time after they've happened?
Um… not really, I don’t think. I mean, I might think about something awkward for a bit, but I don’t usually sit with it for a long time.
Do you often find yourself worrying about the future?
Not really… I mean, I think about stuff coming up sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’m usually worrying about the future.
Do you have trouble paying attention in other areas of your life, not just at work?

Yeah… I mean, not just work. It happens there a lot though. Like I’ll start a shift trying to really focus, but after a while the cutting and weighing and checking labels kind of all runs together. Then I realize I’ve just been staring at the same tray or the log sheet and I’m not really taking in what I’m supposed to do next.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
I’m not sure… not usually, I guess. I don’t think of myself as doing things without thinking, but maybe sometimes I do little stuff without really noticing.
Do you often have thoughts or concerns that keep coming back to you and won't leave your mind?
Um… not really, I don’t think so. I mean, I can get stuck thinking about something for a bit, but not like it won’t leave my mind.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge?
Not really… I mean, I get stressed sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’m nervous or on edge a lot.
Do you often feel afraid or fearful for no specific reason?
No… I don’t think so. I can’t really think of times where I feel afraid for no reason.
Did you have trouble paying attention or acting impulsively when you were a kid?

Yeah… mostly with paying attention, I think. My mom has some old report cards from elementary school, like around fourth grade, that said I was bright but needed a lot of reminders to finish classwork and turn in homework. I remember understanding the lessons, but I’d miss parts of the instructions unless the teacher was kind of nearby.
Do you often feel anxious or uneasy even when there's no apparent reason to feel that way?
Not really. I mean… I get uneasy if there’s something going on, but not for no reason that I’ve noticed.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things in general, even when there's nothing specific happening?
No, not really. I mean… I worry if there’s something I need to deal with, but I don’t think I’m just worrying all the time for no reason.
Do you often find yourself having persistent thoughts or feelings of anxiety that interfere with your daily activities?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get stressed sometimes, but not like persistent anxiety taking over my day or anything.
